free_service.verified_open_source_or_educational_proj: official support page says unlimited API requests are available

request_limit_test.reason: The repository has no verified open-source qualification or written authorization for the intended public investment-research use, so quota probing would not establish canonical-source eligibility.

decision_reason: The official support page conditions unlimited requests on verified open-source or educational-project status; this repository has no provider verification evidence.

The official Terms of Service grants personal non-commercial use by default unless otherwise agreed in writing and lists investment analysis, research, testing, and monitoring among commercial-use examples.
The intended public investment-research pipeline therefore lacks documented authorization under the default license.
Tokyo/Japanese symbol rules and public redistribution terms were not verified from official documentation, and unsupported details are not inferred.
reconsideration_condition: Re-evaluate only after written provider authorization/qualification and explicit data-use/redistribution terms for this repository are available.
